fact: Decree No. 148/PR/2026 of 23 March 2026 promulgated Law No. 003/AN-SENAT/2026, ratifying Ordinance No. 001/PR/2026 reforming ANSICE, which brings artificial intelligence into the state's regulatory field and strengthens the agency's powers.
title: Tchad : promulgation de la réforme de l'ANSICE
